title: AI TV Commercials for Small Business: Create & Air from $30/Day

facts.fact: Adwave says it runs AI-generated commercials on streaming TV, Meta, and Google the same day, with media starting at $30/day.
facts.quote: Adwave runs it on streaming TV, Meta, and Google the same day from $30/day.

facts.fact: The vendor's page says traditional TV commercial production costs $10,000-$50,000+, citing 'industry sources'.
facts.quote: Total cost: $10,000-$50,000+ according to industry sources.

facts.fact: Media Culture, a third-party source cited by the page, says traditional TV commercial production can range from $1,000 to $1,000,000 depending on complexity.
facts.quote: According to Media Culture, traditional TV commercial production can range from $1,000 to $1,000,000 depending on complexity.

facts.fact: The page states that a professionally produced agency commercial typically costs $10,000 to $50,000.
facts.quote: A professionally produced commercial from an agency typically runs $10,000 to $50,000.

facts.fact: The page lists concept and script costs for a traditional commercial at $1,000-$5,000.
The page lists production crew costs for a traditional commercial at $2,000-$10,000 per day.
The page lists talent fees for a traditional commercial at $500-$5,000+ per actor.
The page lists equipment rental for a traditional commercial at $1,000-$5,000.
The page lists location fees for a traditional commercial at $500-$5,000.
The page lists post-production costs for a traditional commercial at $2,000-$10,000.
The page says traditional TV commercial production takes at least 6 to 12 weeks in total.
The vendor's page says its AI workflow takes under 10 minutes in total and that the creation cost is often $0, with the customer paying only to run the ad.
facts.quote: Total time: Under 10 minutes. Total creation cost: Often $0 (you pay only to run the ad).

facts.fact: The vendor states that its Wavemaker tool generates a broadcast-ready commercial in about 2 minutes.
facts.quote: AI generates a broadcast-ready commercial in about 2 minutes.

facts.fact: The vendor's example of a traditional route for a small business testing TV advertising puts the cost at $15,000-$25,000 (production plus a modest campaign).
The vendor describes its AI route as starting from $30/day in media with campaign ads included and no separate production bill.
facts.quote: AI route:** from $30/day media, with campaign ads included and no separate production bill

facts.fact: The page says the AI-generated result is a 30-second commercial intended for local and regional streaming campaigns.
facts.quote: The result is a 30-second commercial for local and regional streaming campaigns.

facts.fact: The page says each review-and-tweak cycle on the AI workflow takes 1-2 minutes per edit.
facts.quote: Review and request any tweaks (1-2 minutes per edit)

facts.fact: The page recommends AI commercials for budget-conscious campaigns under $10,000 total.
